issues.legal_issue: When a tenant on a short-term lease builds a structure on leased land, the land and structure may be assessed as one unit, with primary liability for property tax resting on the land lessor.
material_facts: The landowner had let the land to a tenant on a monthly basis.
The tenant had built a tiled house on the land at the tenant’s own cost.
The municipal corporation assessed the land and house together and placed the primary tax liability on the landowner.
The lease was not for a term exceeding one year.
issues.conclusion: The composite assessment was proper, and the landowner, as lessor of the land, was primarily liable for the property tax. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 3(r) and 3(s) define land and buildings broadly, while sections 140 and 154–156 support assessment of property and determination of rateable value and the primarily liable person. Under section 146(2)(a), where premises are let, property tax is primarily leviable from the lessor; in a composite assessment involving a tenant-built structure, the lessor for this purpose is the lessor of the land. Section 146(3) shifts primary liability to the tenant only where the land has been let for a term exceeding one year and the tenant or a person deriving title from the tenant has built on it. Section 147 provides for recovery by the lessor of tax paid beyond the amount attributable to the rent received. The Court also relied on the principle of contemporanea expositio, citing Ohlson’s case [1891] 1 Q.B. 485 and Clyde Navigation Trustees v. Laird, 8 A.C. 658, and upheld the interpretation in Ramji Keshavji v. Municipal Corporation for Greater Bombay, 56 Bom. L.R. 1132.

rule.if: property_tax_assessment_appeal and land_leased_to_tenant and tenant_built_structure and lease_term_not_over_one_year and composite_property_assessment

predicates.property_tax_assessment_appeal: The proceeding challenged a municipal assessment that imposed property-tax liability.
predicates.land_leased_to_tenant: The owner let the land to a tenant.
predicates.tenant_built_structure: The tenant built a structure on the leased land.
predicates.lease_term_not_over_one_year: The land was not leased for a term exceeding one year.
predicates.composite_property_assessment: The authority assessed the land and the structure together as one unit.

issues.definition: When a property-tax assessment appeal concerns land let to a tenant who built a structure on it, the lease does not exceed one year, and the land and structure are assessed together, the land lessor is primarily liable for the tax.
